reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text:
I downloaded this because I saw an advertisement. I used it for 2 nights, both nights I tossed and turned all night, didn’t sleep much at all. Both mornings the SleepSense app said I have a perfect sleep score for the previous night. The app doesn’t work.

*update* the developer commented. In response: my phone was right by my pillow, it should have picked up every noise and didn’t. 2 nights in a row, I used the app, didn’t sleep well either night, both nights had a 100% sleep score. My phone was right by my pillow- it didn’t even pick up my 3 dogs barking in my room on the second night. The app doesn’t work, and it doesn’t look like what’s advertised. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Downloaded and tried to use the first night-button to even start tracking didn’t work. Killed the app, restarted app, still didn’t work. Tried again last night and it actually let me track my sleep. However, after an hour of analyzing my sleep report (and being able to see nothing), I went back to my sleep summary and it said “no sleep report for this day.”  App is up to date and phone iOS is up to date
